title: Psalm 101: A King's Vow of Integrity
summary: A king promises to sing of God's loving devotion and justice and then vows how he will live and rule. At home he will walk with integrity and keep worthless things from his eyes. At court he will silence slanderers, refuse the proud, choose faithful people as his servants, bar liars from his presence, and every morning remove the wicked from the city of the LORD.

from.where: The Study Bible's introduction to the Psalms
from.text: Royal psalms are about the king of Israel: his crowning, his wedding, his battles, God's promise to his family (Psalms 2, 18, 20, 21, 45, 72, 89, 101, 110, 132, 144).

line: A king's vow of integrity: to walk in his own house with a whole heart, keep worthless things from his eyes, and refuse slander and pride at his court.
guide: You have a house too: a home, a workplace, a set of friends, a screen. Ask what you set before your eyes there and what talk you allow. Begin with your own heart, and pray the question of verse 2, since integrity is not built alone.

stanzas.title: A song of loving devotion and justice
The king's own heart and house
Whom the king will refuse and whom he will welcome
Every morning, justice in the city of the LORD

verses.t: A Psalm of David. I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
I will ponder the way that is blameless— when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.
I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.
Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.
No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.
Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
